_register: Formal vous (never tu) in sentences addressed to the reader; buttons, menu entries and step lists use the infinitive (Prêter, Enregistrer, Scanner le code-barres); no jokes, no exclamation marks; inclusive middle-dot forms are not used (write « élève », « enseignant »).
_quotes: French guillemets « text » with a non-breaking space inside each guillemet (U+00A0, or U+202F narrow no-break space), and a non-breaking space before : ; ? ! (e.g. « Prêté : « {{title}} » »); nested quotes use “ ”; the arrow → stays.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; never « copie ».

record.note: Bibliographic record, as in Koha and in French school libraries (BCD/CDI).

patron.note: Usual word in BCD/CDI and in PMB; Koha says « adhérent ». Plural « lecteurs » in the menu.

card.note: Short form « carte » where the context is clear.

return.note: The action: « Retour » on the menu, « retourner » or « enregistrer le retour » for the verb.

renew.note: Used in French libraries for extending the due date; Koha says « renouveler ». Keep one of the two everywhere.

due date.note: Short form of « date de retour prévue ».

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine, as in French libraries.

spine band.note: The coloured band with pictogram and cote on the spine; « pastille » is used for a round sticker only.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; « inventaire » means the register of acquisitions in French libraries, so it is not used here.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « desiderata » is also understood but less plain.

census.note: Registering the lecteurs with their photo.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year.

colour set.note: Written « couleur »; « palette » for the interface palette.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « lecteur de codes-barres » is the formal name but clashes with « lecteur » for patron, so « douchette » is used in labels and in text.

teacher.note: Feminine « enseignante » only where the gender is known; the plain form is « enseignant ».

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled, as in CDI; the area as a whole is « Prêts ».
